messages:
eli: quick heads-up — canary run of combo int4+fp8 (redwood-v2-7b) on the legal_contracts prompt set shows a quality regression vs int8 baseline. small but consistent. need async triage + microbench.
samir: how big is "small"? any example diffs? was this on canary or a full sweep?
maya: numbers: EM down ~3.4% on contract-clause tests, pplx ~+2.1. observed repetition/tail looping in ~6% of samples on long prompts. ran on canary-stack02 (dedicated). attached quick diff snippet below.
eli: thanks — can you paste a couple failing outputs inline? also where's the run config and PR?
maya: sample prompt: "Review clause: ..."
int8 output: "Clause is void if..."
int4+fp8 output: "Clause is void if if if..."
small but visible generation collapse. run config: model=redwood-v2-7b, quant=int4+fp8, seq=4096, batch=4. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321
ciara: can we get a sweep over seq lengths? my hypothesis: fp8 noise + kv fragmentation at long seqs causes cache re-use issues. propose seqs [512,1024,2048,4096] and latency/quality sampling.
samir: +1. also capture topk logits for first 64 tokens for diff analysis.
ciara: planned command (quick):
```
./bench/run_micro.sh --model redwood-v2-7b --quant int4+fp8 --seq 512,1024,2048,4096 --batch 4 --save-logs /tmp/canary-int4-fp8
```
will add --dump-logits for topk.
bench-bot: scheduled microbench job 1763002000 on canary-stack02. will post artifacts to s3://redwood-infra/bench/1763001234/
deploy-bot: canary traffic currently at 10% for redwood-v2-7b-int4-fp8. automatic fallback policy set to int8 on >1.5% regression for EM.
samir: fallback threshold seems fine, but I'd rather run a targeted rollback if EM drop >2.5% for contract set. can we tweak routing to prefer int8 for routes matching /legal/* ?
eli: i've opened runtime routing PR for canary routing tweaks: https://github.com/redwood-inference/orchestration/pull/1190 — adds policy rule: if route matches /legal/* prefer int8 when quality delta > 1%.
maya: reviewers? tagging @ciara @samir for perf/ops review :eyes:
ciara: i'll review the routing PR and run the seq sweep. timeline: start sweep in ~30m, should finish in ~3h. will collect diffs and topk dumps.
samir: if ciara sees regression reproducing, can you paste a minimal repro prompt + model outputs here so we can add to the eval set? we'll need that for an eval alert.
ciara: will do. uploading artifacts to s3 link once done: s3://redwood-infra/bench/1763001234/artifacts.tar.gz
maya: plan: 1) ciara runs sweep, 2) analyze topk diffs, 3) eli/samir decide fallback/rollback, 4) add minimal repro to eval + gating. I'll run full sweep by EOD and post final numbers. @samir @ciara
eli: thanks — also adding a quick QA note for release: "watch legal_contracts EM and tail-loop counts". keep this thread for updates :thumbsup:
samir: thanks all. ping me if you need extra GPU for the sweep.
ciara: starting now. will post logs + summary when finished. :rocket:
